drafts.text: Retatrutide is a triple agonist for GLP-1, GIP, and glucagon receptors. Glucagon receptor agonism may increase energy expenditure, contributing to its observed efficacy in Phase 2 trials.

drafts.text: BPC-157's pro-angiogenic effect was first noted in 1993 in a rat model of gastric ulcer. Subsequent rodent studies show increased VEGF and eNOS expression in injured tissues, though specific human trials on angiogenesis are still needed.

drafts.target_text: @PeptideFrontier Mechanistic elegance still needs outcome data. Appetite, glycemia, lean mass and adverse effects can move in different directions, so the useful comparison is the patient full benefit risk ledger.
drafts.text: The SURMOUNT-1 Phase 3 trial (2022) showed tirzepatide led to a mean weight reduction of 22.5% at 72 weeks with the highest dose, compared to 3.1% with placebo, in adults with obesity or overweight. This was in addition to glycemic control.
